title: Rhubarb Pie
directions: Put 1/2 c. sugar & butter in pan with rhubarb, cook till soft.
Mix 1/2 c. sugar with cornstarch - add beaten egg yolk with cream - add to first mixture & cook till thick. (Cool.)
Pour into baked pastry shell.
For top - make meringue (add icing sugar).
notes: Large "R" written over the title in darker ink

starch - add beaten egg yolk with cream -
add to first mixture & cook till thick (Cool)
Pour into baked pastry shell. -
For Top - Make meringue (add icing sugar).

title: Maids of Honor - Tarts
directions: Mix jam & almonds. Place spoonfuls in each pastry shell.
Bake @ 400° for 10-15 min.
When cool, serve with whipped cream, sweetened with honey.

title: After Dinner Mint Pie
ingredients: 2 cups (24) crushed cream filled chocolate cookies
directions: Combine crumbs and margarine, reserve 1/2 cup
raw_text:
AFTER DINNER MINT PIE
2 cups (24) crushed cream filled chocolate cookies
1/4 cup margarine (melted)
1/4 cup milk
1 - 7 oz jar Kraft marshmallow creme.
few drops peppermint extract
few drops green food coloring
2 cups whipping cream (whipped)
Combine crumbs and margarine, reserve 1/2 cup

title: After Dinner Mint Pie
directions: for topping. Press remaining crumb mixture onto bottom of 9" pie plate. Chill.
Gradually add milk to marshmallow creme, mixing until well blended.
Add extract & food coloring, fold in whipped cream.
Pour into pan; freeze until firm. Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.

title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: Place in layers in lg roaster - put Aylmer tomato soup over each layer. At end pour 1/2 c water over all.
Any extra leaves - place on top.
Place in oven 325° - 2 1/2 - 3 hrs.
Note: can cook rice in 350° oven. - Boil water - 2 c rice 4 c water & add salt, pepper. - Stir, cover & place in oven for 20 min. - (then cool & rest & add).
notes: * Anna - never freezes cabbage leaves before using.

title: Cabbage Rolls
directions: To cook rice - boil water - 2 c rice - 4 c water. Preheat oven to 350° - pour boiled water over raw rice & stir, add salt to taste, cover & place in oven for 20 min.

Cabbage - Copenhagen cabbage (not winter cabbage) - steam & take off leaves as tender to fork - stack & role in freezer at least overnight

title: Macaroni & Cheese (Deluxe)
ingredients: 4 c cheese - sharp or med, grated
directions: Cook macaroni in water & oil & salt until tender - but firm, about 5-7 min. Drain.
Return macaroni to pot. Add remain. ingred. Mix.
Pour into 2 1/2 q - 3 l. greased casserole. Bake uncovered in 350° for 30-40 min.
Serves 8.
